decisions.executionNote: Remember the first object: a dark blue Nokia-style keypad phone. Let this reference pass and watch for its return.
Prepare the left arm slowly in its own workspace, raising and beginning a downward grasp orientation while the reference phone travels away.
Continue a smooth elbow-up approach to a high left-side waiting pose. The reference blue phone is still departing.
Move the left wrist forward above the belt and rotate toward a top-down pickup, maintaining the same elbow-up branch.
Finish preparing a high, nearly vertical left-hand grasp pose while keeping clear of the departing reference phone.
Settle the left gripper above the incoming lane, open and vertical, without touching the reference phone.
Hold clear of the conveyor while the first blue keypad phone departs; watch the incoming left edge.
Wait for the reference phone to leave and inspect subsequent objects; keep both grippers clear and open.
Continue observing; the remembered target is the blue keypad phone, now at the outgoing edge.
Keep the prepared left arm stationary and watch for the blue phone to reappear among following objects.
The initial phone has nearly cleared the outgoing edge. Hold ready and observe new arrivals.
The reference has left. Continue monitoring for the matching blue keypad phone.
Watch incoming objects for the remembered blue Nokia-style phone; maintain the high open waiting pose.
An incoming buttoned object is partly visible; wait for a clear view before deciding whether it matches the blue phone.
The new black object appears to be a game controller, not the remembered phone. Let it pass while monitoring.
Hold the high waiting pose and let the nonmatching black controller pass.
Continue observing the incoming sequence; the black controller does not match the remembered blue phone.
The incoming black object is now recognizable as a camera, not the blue keypad phone. Continue waiting.
Let the nonmatching camera pass and inspect the following object.
Keep clear of the nonmatching camera and white cup; look for the blue phone behind them.
Observe the incoming sequence without grasping the camera or cup; the target remains the blue keypad phone.
Maintain clearance and watch behind the cup for the returning blue phone.
Wait with the gripper above the belt; neither the camera nor cup matches the reference phone.
A blue phone is beginning to emerge behind the cup. Wait for a clear view and a reachable interception point.
The returning object matches the blue keypad phone. Align the left wrist with its lane while increasing clearance over the preceding cup.
Hold above the lane until the preceding cup clears; the matching phone is approaching the left pickup workspace.
Shift the open left gripper slightly upstream for the returning blue phone and align across its narrow body, staying above the cup.
Begin a shallow descent at the left interception point as the cup clears and the matching phone approaches.
Lower the open gripper toward the phone's height while waiting for it to reach the interception point; keep clear of the preceding cup.
Descend another small increment as the matching phone reaches the open jaws; reassess alignment before closing.
Track the returning phone downstream while making a small height and lane correction with the jaws open.
Let the phone center in the jaws, then close fully while matching its downstream motion. Retention will be checked visually.
Keep the jaws fully closed and lift the matching phone vertically; verify that it remains between the fingers and clears the belt.
The phone stayed on the belt, so reopen and reapproach farther downstream with a small forward correction for a deeper grasp.
Track the phone and lower the open jaws to its sides, with a small forward correction to bring the body into the grasp region.
Finish the deeper approach and close fully on the phone's body while following conveyor motion. Check retention before a full lift.
The phone is visibly centered between the closing jaws. Keep fully closed and lift vertically, checking that the phone rises with the hand.
The matching phone is retained but has rotated in the jaws. Lift higher with a slight retreat to ensure the whole phone clears the belt by over 10 cm.
